THE GAME

Co-op · Horror · Extraction

Trash Corp. is a cooperative horror extraction game for 1 to 4 players. Drive a space garbage truck and travel between planets. Fight radioactive monsters. Do whatever it takes to survive and hit the quota!

Every trip lands on a new planet, generated from scratch: different surfaces, ruins and structures to break into. Grab everything of value, deal with whatever lives down there and get back to the truck before it's too late.

The corporation raises the quota every cycle, and what you bring back pays for the upgrades that keep your crew alive on the next run.

WHAT'S INSIDE

01

A new planet every trip

Surfaces, ruins and structures are generated for each run, so no two drops look the same.

02

Loot and extract

Fill the truck with anything worth credits. It only counts once you make it back.

03

Hit the quota

The corporation raises the bar every cycle, and it's never satisfied for long.

04

Something lives out there

Radioactive monsters don't like visitors. Stick together.

05

Upgrade the crew

Spend what you earn on perks that carry into the next run.

06

Stay on comms

Built-in voice chat keeps the crew talking, or screaming, while you work.
